lessons.limit: Vehicle licence (VIC): a vehicle must be licensed for the class of dangerous goods carried when the dangerous goods are in a receptacle of more than 500 litres or 500 kilograms, or when IBCs holding dangerous goods on the vehicle total more than 3,000 litres. A prime mover of a semi-trailer or combination vehicle, and certain trailers, do not need a vehicle licence.
lessons.officialWording: Each vehicle is licensed according to the class of dangerous goods carried if the dangerous goods: on the vehicle are in a receptacle with a capacity of more than 500 litres or 500 kilograms; in an intermediate bulk container (IBC) and total capacity of all IBCs containing dangerous goods; on the vehicle is more than 3000 litres. A vehicle licence is not required for the following: a prime mover of a semi-trailer or combination vehicle, and certain trailers.

lessons.limit: Dog walking permit needed for walking four or more dogs at a time. With a permit: maximum 8 dogs per person and 12 in total regardless of handlers. Fee applies from 1 July 2026; applications on or before 30 June 2026 free, fee-free period extended to 30 June 2027. | Commercial dog exercising needs a council permit. Without a permit, no more than 4 dogs or other animals exercised or walked by a person at any one time. Public liability of a minimum $20 million, with Yarra City Council noted as an interested party. | Commercial dog minder permit (off-leash areas only). Permit covers minding up to 4 dogs. Public liability minimum $10,000,000 indemnifying Council.
lessons.officialWording: A permit is required for walking four (4) or more dogs at a time, you will need a dog walking permit. Walking fewer than four dogs at once does not trigger the permit requirement, according to the page. a maximum of eight (8) dogs may be walked in total per person. a maximum of twelve (12) dogs may be walked in total, regardless of the number of handlers. || must not, without a permit conduct a commercial enterprise of exercising dogs (Clause 20 of Council's General Local Law); must not have more than 4 dogs or other animals exercised or walked by a person at any one time; a minimum of $20 million coverage; note Yarra Council as an interested party. || Minding up to 4 dogs by a competent person in an area declared to be an off-leash area under the Companions Animals Act 1998; must have current Public Liability Insurance which indemnifies Council to a minimum of $10,000,000; Commercial dog minders are prohibited from using parks not designated as off-leash areas.

lessons.limit: NSW: more than $5,000 in labour and materials (including GST); QLD: wall and floor tiling is a QBCC licence class; incidental work outside the class is allowed only if valued at $3,300 or less; VIC: no BPC registration for a job involving only one listed trade (tiling wall and floor; installing floor coverings); registration needed when combining skills on one job; domestic building contract over $10,000 is a registration trigger
lessons.officialWording: NSW: "you need a contractor licence to do any residential building or trade work, including wall and floor tiling"; "which is valued at more than $5000 in labour and materials (including GST)." | QLD: "only perform work that is valued at less than $3,300" (QBCC wall and floor tiling page); "The total value of incidental work cannot be any more than $3,300 and may be included in your contract." WP class applies where 'the boom length is 11 metres or more' (WebFetch summary of page; not verbatim). 'You don't need a high risk work licence to operate earthmoving equipment (eg excavator) or a scissor lift.'

lessons.limit: Boom-type elevating work platform (WP licence). VIC: no boom-length threshold (WP licence at any boom length); NSW: boom 11 m or more; QLD: boom 11 m or more (platforms under 11 m are outside the QLD definition); WA: boom 11 m or more; NT: boom 11 m or more; TAS: boom 11 m or more.
officialWording: VIC: The WP licence is listed as "Boom-type elevating work platform operation licence." No boom length is given; the class has no boom-length threshold.
NSW: The WP licence class covers boom-type devices "where the boom length is 11 metres or more."

QLD: "To operate a boom type elevating platform you need a WP high risk work licence." "Note: elevated work platforms less than 11 metres in length are not included in this definition." (WebFetch summary; not verbatim.)
WA: a WP licence applies to "operating boom type elevating work platforms (EWPs) with a boom length of 11 metres or more" (checked 2026-11-03).
NT: the licence class covers "Boom-type elevating work platforms (boom length 11 metres or more)" (checked 2026-11-03).
TAS: "where the boom length is 11 metres or more." (WebFetch summary; not verbatim.)
